verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's AI tools page says users can 'create campaigns with the AI you already use. Without leaving the chat,' which indicates natural-language campaign creation through an external chat assistant. Generative AI features are listed on the pricing page, and Analytics AI gives plain-language explanations, but that is natural-language output rather than command input. Missing for 10: evidence of broad natural-language control beyond campaign creation (audiences, automations, sending, reporting), detail on how the chat integration works and what it supports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
